title: The Black Jew Wealth Coach - Research Results
description: Structured current-market SEO, search-intent, competitor, Ubersuggest keyword, content-strategy, and content-opportunity research for The Black Jew Wealth Coach and Brandon Gardner.

request_id.description: Unique Request ID generated using the current date and 24-hour time in the format BWC-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.

content_type.description: Selected content format. For the normal weekday article workflow, use SEO Blog.

topic_area.description: Primary subject area for the selected content opportunity.

target_audience.description: Specific audience most likely to benefit from the selected topic.

business_goal.description: Primary business objective supported by the content.

search_location.description: Geographic search market used for the research. Use United States unless a more specific location is appropriate.

research_priority.description: Priority assigned to the content opportunity.

ubersuggest_available.description: True only when the connected Ubersuggest MCP tool successfully returned keyword data during this run.

search_volume.description: Actual monthly search volume returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Return an empty string when unavailable.

seo_difficulty.description: Actual SEO Difficulty returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Return an empty string when unavailable.

paid_difficulty.description: Actual Paid Difficulty returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Return an empty string when unavailable.

cost_per_click.description: Actual cost-per-click value returned by Ubersuggest for the primary keyword. Return an empty string when unavailable.

keyword_trend.description: Actual keyword trend or seasonality information returned by Ubersuggest. Return an empty string when unavailable.

ubersuggest_related_keywords.description: Related keyword opportunities returned by Ubersuggest, separated by semicolons. Return an empty string when unavailable.

ubersuggest_competitor_gaps.description: Competitor keyword gaps or opportunities identified through Ubersuggest. Return an empty string when unavailable.

related_service.description: Most relevant known Brandon Gardner service connected to the topic. Return an empty string when none clearly applies.

related_book.description: Most relevant known Brandon Gardner book connected to the topic. Return an empty string when none clearly applies.

cta.description: Recommended call to action aligned with the selected topic and business goal.

special_instructions.description: Topic-specific writing cautions, compliance notes, emphasis, or editorial instructions for the article-writing stage.

primary_keyword.description: Primary SEO keyword selected or confirmed for the content opportunity.

secondary_keywords.description: Relevant secondary keywords, long-tail terms, and semantic variations separated by semicolons.

search_intent.description: Dominant search intent for the selected topic.

search_demand_summary.description: Concise explanation of what searchers want to learn, compare, solve, find, or accomplish.

people_also_ask.description: Relevant search questions separated by semicolons.

related_searches.description: Relevant related searches and long-tail opportunities separated by semicolons.

competitor_urls.description: Specific competing-content URLs actually identified during current research, separated by semicolons.

competitor_strengths.description: Evidence-based summary of what current competing content does well.

competitor_gaps.description: Evidence-based summary of meaningful gaps, weaknesses, or missed opportunities in competing content.

unique_content_angle.description: Recommended differentiated content angle based on audience needs, competitor gaps, search intent, and business goals.

recommended_title.description: SEO-focused working title aligned with the primary keyword, current research, search intent, and brand positioning.

recommended_outline.description: Substantive H2 and H3 article outline capable of supporting a detailed publication-ready article.

opportunity_score.description: Content-opportunity score based on brand relevance, usefulness, search intent, business fit, competitive gap, SEO opportunity, conversion potential, and differentiation.

ai_recommendation.description: Strategic recommendation for the later article-writing step.

research_sources.description: Specific authoritative URLs actually accessed during current research, separated by semicolons. Do not invent URLs.
